readme:
# Xiaomi Market Bypass An LSPosed module that helps Xiaomi Market run correctly on AOSP and crDroid ROMs. ## What it fixes - Missing MIUI framework classes and methods used by Xiaomi Market. - Xiaomi Market compatibility checks that can crash or block flows on AOSP. - Invalid Settings.Secure writes from a normal third-party app. - PackageInstaller confirmation started while Xiaomi Market is in the background. - Installs that remain stuck after a committed install session. ## Requirements - Android with LSPosed installed. - Xiaomi Market installed as `com.xiaomi.market`. - Enable this module for `com.xiaomi.market` and `com.android.providers.downloads` in LSPosed. ## Usage 1. Install the module APK. 2. Enable the module in LSPosed. 3. Select `com.xiaomi.market` and `com.android.providers.downloads` as the module scope. 4. Force stop Xiaomi Market and the DownloadProvider, or reboot the device. The DownloadProvider scope is required for pause and resume on AOSP/crDroid ROMs whose provider does not reschedule a paused download when the Market resumes it. ## Tested Validated with Xiaomi Market v4.111.0 on a Xiaomi Redmi Note 13 4G (`sapphire`) running crDroid Android 16. For source updates, issue reports, and the latest documentation, visit the [source repository](https://github.com/pbzin/XiaomiMarketBypass). # 小米市场绕过 LSPosed 模块，帮助小米市场在 AOSP 和 crDroid ROM 上正确运行。 ## 它修复了什么 - 缺少小米市场使用的MIUI框架类和方法。 - 小米市场兼容性检查可能会导致 AOSP 崩溃或阻塞流量。 - 无效的设置。从正常的第三方应用程序安全写入。 - 当小米市场在后台时，PackageInstaller 确认开始。 - 在提交的安装会话之后安装仍然卡住。 ## 要求 - 安装了 LSPod 的 Android。 - 小米市场安装为“com.xiaomi.market”。 - 在 LSPod 中为“com.xiaomi.market”和“com.android.providers.downloads”启用此模块。 ## 用法 1.安装模块APK。 2. 在 LSPod 中启用该模块。 3. 选择“com.xiaomi.market”和“com.android.providers.downloads”作为模块范围。 4.强行停止小米市场和DownloadProvider，或者重启设备。 在 AOSP/crDroid ROM 上暂停和恢复需要 DownloadProvider 范围，这些 ROM 的提供商在市场恢复时不会重新安排暂停的下载。 ## 已测试 已在运行 crDroid Android 16 的小米红米 Note 13 4G（“蓝宝石”）上使用小米市场 v4.111.0 进行验证。 如需源更新、问题报告和最新文档，请访问[源存储库](https://github.com/pbzin/XiaomiMarketBypass)。 [![下载](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Xiaomi%20Market%20Bypass-orange?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.pb.xiaomimarketbypass/releases) ### 💖 支持我的工作
